as_told.title: Three flying saucers hover over a church at a Port Arthur school
as_told.place_text: Port Arthur, Texas, USA (DQ Queen Elementary)

plain: In 1961, at De Queen Elementary School in Port Arthur, Texas, three flying saucers hung over a church "maybe 25 to 50 ft in the air," according to Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who once guarded nuclear weapons. He tells Michels he was five or six when his mother pointed and said, "look Anthony look at those flying saucers," and that they were "beautiful." In a later telling he names his mother and his sister as having seen them too.
